Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. (i) Only Manufacturers or their authorized dealers distributors (except for Q1 & Q2 category) need to qu ote with bid specific authorization from the manufacturers failing which offer will be summarily rejected. (ii). In case bidders participate as an authorized agent, then the performance as required above shall be th at of the Principal, authorizing the agent. It may so happen that the agent has credentials of past supply for a different Principal but this will not be considered as performance for placing bulk order in case of change of Principal. 2. (i) The Bidder should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 20% of bid quantity, in at leas t one of the last three financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization/ PSU / Public Listed Company. Copies of relevant contracts (proving supply of cumulative order quantity in any one financial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant finan cial year. The similar product category will be the bid item having same description, but of different sizes/r atings/capacities The bidder is required to submit proof of successful supply. Purchase order alone shall no t be considered as work experience. In case of any documents submitted by bidders are found to be forge d or fake, the concerned bidder shall be debarred for future purchases and the action of suspension from t he GeM shall also be initiated. ii) The onus of submission of requisite documents such as copies CRAC, CRN, Receipt note shall be respons ibility of the bidder. iii) No fresh documents will be accepted after bid opening also not be accepted in representation. 3. Valid BIS certification of the bid item of the bidder should accompany their bid. 4. Firm must submit the required test reports as mentioned in Annexure-A at the time of bidding, failing w hich the offer will be summarily rejected.

5. It is desirable that OEM/Authorized bidder to have an In house NABL accredited Lab. But in case the sam e is not available, TPI or Railway representative or both should conduct the acceptance test listed in Annex ure 'A' from a NABL accredited Lab. The testing charge in any case to be borne by the bidder. 6. The material will be delivered at the Haridwar Station. . 6.
